create_CosineLRScheduleConfig: create a CosineLRScheduleConfig dataclass to configure warmup updates, max lr, min lr, and period settings
run_step_update: run step_update on CosineLRSchedule to compute the learning rate after a given number of training updates
review_CosineLRSchedule_init: review the CosineLRSchedule constructor to understand how warmup, period, and shrink factors are initialized
